# dev-v2-ext

120 further development cases for policy version 3 (drafted as base version 2): variants of the 80 dev-v2 scenarios with the movable parameters
moved (2701-2760 NO_SHOW_CHARGE, 2801-2860 ROUTE_DEVIATION). dev-v2 and dev-v2-ext together are the 200-case set;
`split.json` here partitions all 200 (`covers`) into calibration (133) and holdout (67). No identifier is shared with
dev-v2 or with any other set.

As in dev-v2, this directory holds only the cases, `index.json`, `split.json`, `CANARY.txt` and this note; everything
that describes outcomes is under `eval/answers/dev-v2-ext/`. Generated by `eval/synth/make_dev_set.py --size 200`;
checked by `eval/synth/verify_dev_set.py dev-v2-ext`; tested by `tests/test_dev_v2.py`. Run dev-v2 first and read its
misses; use the 200 together to choose the escalation threshold on the calibration part only.
